entities.name: Initial registration procedure
entities.description: Procedure initiated by UE in 5GMM-DEREGISTERED state to register for 5GS services, emergency services, SMS over NAS, onboarding services, or disaster roaming services.

entities.name: REGISTRATION REQUEST
entities.description: NAS message sent by UE to AMF to initiate registration procedure.

entities.name: 5GMM-DEREGISTERED
entities.description: UE state from which initial registration procedure is initiated.

entities.name: T3510
entities.description: Timer started when UE sends REGISTRATION REQUEST message.

entities.name: T3502
entities.description: Timer that shall be stopped if running when UE initiates registration procedure.

entities.name: T3511
entities.description: Timer that shall be stopped if running when UE initiates registration procedure.

entities.name: 5GS mobile identity IE
entities.description: Information element containing UE identity such as 5G-GUTI, SUCI, or PEI.

entities.name: UE status IE
entities.description: Information element indicating UE registration status in EMM.

entities.name: 5GS update type IE
entities.description: Information element used to request SMS over NAS support.

entities.name: Requested NSSAI IE
entities.description: Information element containing network slice selection assistance information.

entities.name: Initial registration triggers
entities.description: Conditions that trigger UE to initiate initial registration procedure.

relations.description: Initial registration procedure is initiated when UE is in 5GMM-DEREGISTERED state.
Initial registration procedure is initiated by sending REGISTRATION REQUEST message.
UE starts timer T3510 when sending REGISTRATION REQUEST message.
UE stops timer T3502 if running when initiating registration procedure.
UE stops timer T3511 if running when initiating registration procedure.
REGISTRATION REQUEST message contains 5GS mobile identity IE.
REGISTRATION REQUEST message contains UE status IE.
REGISTRATION REQUEST message contains 5GS update type IE.
REGISTRATION REQUEST message contains Requested NSSAI IE.
REGISTRATION REQUEST message contains 5GMM capability IE.
Various conditions trigger UE to initiate initial registration procedure.
